hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "(npm\s+install|yarn\s+add|pip\s+install|go\s+get)" && test -f .madd/contract.d/30-technical.json; then FORBIDDEN=$(jq -r ".technical.stack.packages.forbidden // [] | .[]" .madd/contract.d/30-technical.json 2>/dev/null); for pkg in $FORBIDDEN; do if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "$pkg"; then echo "BLOCKED: Package $pkg is in forbidden list (technical.stack.packages.forbidden)" >&2; exit 2; fi; done; fi'

bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".file_path // .path // empty" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -q ".madd/contract.d/"; then echo "WARNING: Writing to contract file $FILE — verify agent has ownership" >&2; fi'
